title: SAT Percentages: Every Type of Percent Question
description:
Percent questions look easy, which is why they cost so many points. This lesson gives you one method, the multiplier, and uses it on every type of SAT percent question, with seven SAT-style practice questions.

You'll learn:
• "What percent" and "percent of" questions
• Percent change (and which number to divide by)
• Back-to-back changes: why they multiply instead of add
• Reverse percent: finding the original price
• Percent of a percent, and the "start with 100" trick
• Percentage points vs percent

All practice questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank (Problem-Solving and Data Analysis → Percentages).
